title: Original CRT catch-object PMD adjustment
limits: Owns the complete 37-byte function at 0x4a8ed0 through exclusive end 0x4a8ef5; no callees, imports or physical fixtures.
Ordinary cdecl calls and optional full source contexts are supported; full source calls retain original saved-ESI stack writes and all arithmetic flag outputs.
Valid readable PMD and conditional virtual-table addresses are required; this leaf does not implement exception selection, dispatch, unwind or rethrow.
notes: Boundary independently verified against pinned original bytes and original-only CPU/full-stack probes. The signed PMD pdisp branch and source stack aliases are detailed in the ignored packet notes.
